title: OneTime Live Lag Performance Fix Packet

reasons: The operator asked about app lag and UI, which is product-quality language requiring evidence before implementation.
Live Playwright and curl readbacks show slow and variable first-byte timing on HTML, static JS/CSS assets, and small APIs.
Existing visual audit defects remain real, but performance lag should not be treated as only component-level UI polish.
affected_product_surfaces: OneTime student and parent review shells
likely_external_provider_blockers: Railway/runtime deploy or restart requires the normal release gate and target guard.
No DNS, payment, email, WAPI, Telegram, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, GHL, LeadConnector, credential, provider-account, or production-data mutation is permitted by this packet.

operator_intent_summary: Make the OneTime app feel fast and polished; classify and fix the live lag without confusing runtime first-byte problems with separate UI chrome defects.
raw_quotes: what about the lag of the app and the ui

decisions_captured.decision: Do not treat the lag complaint as only a visual/UI issue; inspect runtime/hosting response variability and cache/static delivery first.
Shared app-visible implementation remains blocked while active collision lanes exist.

out_of_scope: No email send, WhatsApp/WAPI send, Telegram send, SMS send, Stripe checkout, charge, refund, access grant, password reset, DNS, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, Resend, GHL, LeadConnector, credential, provider-account, or production-data mutation.
No private Operations login or screenshot capture unless an authenticated redaction path is explicitly available.
No raw private message bodies, secrets, passwords, API keys, payment data, or unrelated provider/family records may be committed.
No visual redesign implementation in this packet except changes required to prove performance instrumentation or safe loading states.
affected_surfaces: OneTime live public and review route response time
OneTime provider/student/parent review HTML shell delivery

inspection_targets: Live Playwright lag audit: 18 route/viewport samples, 18 need attention.
Direct TTFB readback: HTML, static JS/CSS, and small APIs show multi-second and variable first-byte timing.
Visual audit: 113 UI findings remain tracked separately in the OneTime frontend audit report.
Control tower and production unblocker: active app/UI/API lanes still block shared implementation.
known_blockers: No unblocked executable production batch currently available.
Hosted deploy/restart and live smoke must wait for the normal release lane.

expanded_phrases.lag: Measure first-byte, document load, FCP, network idle, long tasks, failed requests, console errors, and route/API variability before changing UI.
expanded_phrases.ui: Keep visual defects in the existing UI audit lane; do not use UI polish as a substitute for response-time fixes.
expanded_phrases.slow: A route is slow when initial document/API/static asset response timing is multi-second or variable enough to delay FCP and DCL.
expanded_phrases.polished: Polish requires both fast first render and separately verified visual layout across desktop and mobile.
expanded_phrases.working: Working means live readback shows improved TTFB/FCP/DCL/network idle and no privacy, scope, or action-registry regression.
expanded_phrases.clean: Clean means a non-overlapping implementation lane with tracked proof, not an informal permission to edit shared app files.

requirements.statement: Capture and fix the OneTime live app lag only after classifying whether lag is runtime, cache/static delivery, API, or frontend main-thread work.
requirements.expected_result: After a clean implementation lane, live OneTime routes show materially improved first-byte and first paint timing without scope bleed or external mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh control-tower check shows no overlapping app/UI/API implementation lane.
Runtime and static asset response timing are investigated before component-level UI changes.
No external sends, payments, access grants, provider mutations, DNS changes, or credential writes occur.
Post-fix Playwright lag audit and direct TTFB readback show improvement.
App-visible Done includes commit, push, deploy, and live smoke/readback proof.

criteria: Visual UI defects are linked but scoped separately.
Control tower must be rerun immediately before implementation.
No active overlapping lane may touch the same app/server files.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Open public OneTime route and capture first document response plus FCP/DCL/network idle.
loading.expected_visible_message: Page begins rendering without multi-second first-byte delay.
loading.expected_primary_action: Start Free CTA remains visible after load.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Navigation and primary content landmarks remain discoverable.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading changes must not remove headings, labels, or focusable controls.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Lag audit records timing and screenshot evidence without external writes.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Open member shell without submitting a token or form.
empty.expected_visible_message: Member route renders safe access/login content without private data.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Access form and links keep accessible names.
empty.accessibility_expectation: No horizontal overflow or hidden controls.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Timing evidence distinguishes document response from later helper/widget assets.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Open the classroom review-safe route and wait for visible class content.
populated.expected_visible_message: Classroom review content appears without slow first-byte or failed API stalls.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Content is readable after load and not blocked by indefinite spinner states.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Playwright audit captures DCL/FCP/network idle and screenshot.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Open member library route and inspect any filter/empty state without submitting progress.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: Library remains usable when no filtered item is selected.
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Filter controls have names and remain keyboard reachable.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Mobile controls stay visible and non-overlapping.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Audit records timing and viewport evidence.

error.how_to_enter_state: Run repeat direct readback for small API endpoints and record resets/timeouts as blockers.
error.expected_visible_message: Failures are recorded as runtime blockers, not hidden behind UI polish.
expected_secondary_actions: Inspect runtime logs if approved read-only tooling exists
error.test_smoke_assertion: TTFB readback records status, TTFB, total, and reset/timeout when present.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Attempt only approved read-only runtime inspection; otherwise record blocker.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Missing deploy/runtime access blocks only implementation proof, not the audit record.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Private dashboards must not be screenshotted without redaction.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Blocker includes owner, consequence, and exact next action.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open provider review fixture without logging into Operations.
preview_only.expected_visible_message: Review fixture remains synthetic and scoped to OneTime.
preview_only.accessibility_expectation: No overlap introduced by loading/performance changes.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Screenshot and timing evidence are safe review evidence only.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Run lag audit and direct TTFB readback after implementation.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: Report shows improved timing or a precise blocker.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Post-fix report links command, timing, and deploy/live smoke evidence.

permission_denied.expected_visible_message: Private inspection is skipped and public lag audit continues.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open mobile public route and inspect first viewport plus any fixed helper/nav controls.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Mobile route loads quickly enough that fixed controls do not become the visible failure mode.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Fixed controls remain named and dismissible where applicable.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: No horizontal overflow; tap targets remain usable.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile screenshot and timing evidence are captured.
